model: Active one-mode Hug with the unchanged Burgers clay internal law
forcing: beta times the zero-mean, unit-RMS signed tidal-shaped signal (a/r)^3 sin(2 true_anomaly), in a fixed nonrotating body frame. Chosen model periods and force scale; not a physical gravitational stress calculation.
interpretation: Inertia, parallel restoring stiffness and powered feedback are declared additions, not fitted clay properties. Shear remains one mode; contact opening is not modeled. No additional SIMS trajectories.
